summary: Organigram Global agreed to acquire all of Aurora Cannabis for C$7.80 per share in cash, Organigram stock, or a combination subject to proration, valuing Aurora at roughly C$561 million fully diluted. The price represents a 93% premium to Aurora's unaffected TSX close on August 10, 2026 and a 21% premium to the implied value of Curaleaf's unsolicited hostile bid (amended October 6), which Aurora's board unanimously rejected. Both boards unanimously support the arrangement; directors, officers and a significant Organigram shareholder signed voting support agreements. Watch proration mechanics, the Curaleaf overhang, and regulatory/shareholder approval timing.
